zoe (PM): heads up  big customer reported retrieval drop after we swapped embeddings. They want a formal "schema stability" offer and a short-term migration plan.

omar (eng): can we scope a minimal mitigation: version pin + a simple server-side shim (pad/truncate + renorm)?

lucy (applied-ml): sample shows dim change 1024->768 + different L2 norms. Shim helps but may hide semantic drift. Need eval harness.

zoe (PM): propose policy: 30d grace window for enterprise, default = pin_old, offer auto_adapter or reindex schedule. Weekly evals during grace window.

hannah (acct): legal wants explicit contract language and an opt-in checkbox in console. Also need rollback SLA triggers.

omar (eng): MVP shim pseudocode (pad/truncate + L2):
```python
def compat(v, target):
    v = v[:target] if len(v)>=target else np.pad(v,(0,target-len(v)))
    return v/np.linalg.norm(v)
```

lucy (applied-ml): eval harness: compute top-k overlap, MRR delta, cosine mean shift. Gate: alert>3% MRR drop, block>8% unless waived.

zoe (PM): deliverables: shim + canary route (omar), compat-check CLI + docs (cli-bot), eval harness + threshold tuning (lucy), legal text + UI (hannah).

cli-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/compatibility -> canary 5% on 2026-03-24T01:00Z

hannah (acct): i'll ask for a 10k sample index and baseline vectors from customer. Will draft legal wording per policy.

zoe (PM): also adding "embed_schema_version" and fields to catalog entry: dim, dtype, schema_version, compat_options, grace_period_days, regression_thresholds. Catalog approvals required for schema_version bumps.

lucy (applied-ml): agreed. major schema changes require manual catalog review and passing harness. minor changes can use automated checks.

zoe (PM): thanks all. I'll write the short product note for legal and attach to BigCorp ticket!
